name: parikshaa
description: Parikshaa (परीक्षा) — assessment platform with a tamper-evident exam ledger and an AI micro-viva engine.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/api packages/verify packages/runner --force && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && npm run typecheck -w @parikshaa/web && npm run typecheck -w @parikshaa/console && npm run typecheck -w @parikshaa/e2e
scripts.build:clients: npm run build -w @parikshaa/web && npm run build -w @parikshaa/console
scripts.openapi: npm run build && npm run openapi -w @parikshaa/api
